given; basis mole_fraction; components H2 CH4 TOL BZ BIPH; source: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd, toluene data sheet (BPCL: TOLUENE, conforming to IS 537:2011), https://bharatpetroleum.in/images/files/Data-Sheet-Toluene.pdf, read 2026-11-03, table rows 1, 7, 8, 10, 13: toluene at least 99.8 % by mass, benzene at most 500 mg/kg, non-aromatics at most 0.1 % by mass, C8+ aromatics at most 1000 ppm, water at most 500 ppm. Modelled: benzene at its limit (0.05 % by mass = 0.000590 mol/mol); the other impurities (at most 0.2 % by mass together) are not components of the model and are counted as toluene, ASSUMED (D-020)

The 0.1 % remainder is taken as methane, ASSUMED (the PSA's slip is not stated by the source) (D-020)
